body: Owner asked to open all PRs for review: #191 to #202 marked ready for review with gh pr ready. File-overlap check across all 12 branches against 9b80901: the only shared files are between video-playback and video-recorder, because #202 stacks on #198. Trial integration in a throwaway worktree (since removed): merged all 12 branches in order 191, 192, 198, 195, 202, 193, 199, 196, 200, 201, 194, 197 with no conflicts; flutter analyze clean; full suite 2971 tests passed. Repo deletes head branches on merge, so GitHub retargets #202 onto feat/composer-editor-core when #198 merges. Squash merge is disabled in the repo. No Android APK build was run on the combined tree.
